item.title: After 25 years, the Gothic Remake faithfully overhauls the classic RPG's immersive magic, and now it's finally in sight
item.description: The Gothic Remake release date is set, bringing the iconic PC RPG into the modern era while preserving its vibes, atmosphere, and realism.

item.title: Highguard studio lays off "most" of its devs, Geoff Keighley calls it "an unfortunate, brutal, and sad outcome"
item.description: Highguard developer Wildlight Entertainment has announced a series of layoffs, but "a core group of developers" remains to support the game.

item.title: Already atop my wishlist, Crimson Desert's world might not just have The Witcher 3 beat, but Red Dead Redemption 2 as well
item.description: A new Crimson Desert teaser showing life in Pywel demonstrates the RPG’s camp upgrades, house building, and character customization tools.

item.title: Corsair Sabre V2 Pro Ultralight Wireless review - a nearly perfect ultra light gaming mouse
item.description: Weighing in at just 36g, the Sabre V2 Pro Ultralight Wireless is Corsair's lightest mouse yet, and nearly the one of the best around.

item.title: Epic Games Store is giving away my favorite cyberpunk game for free - a dark, dystopian LA Noire
item.description: The Epic Games Store is giving away Nobody Wants to Die, a neo-dystopian detective game that blends Cyberpunk 2077 with Rockstar's LA Noire.

item.title: Promising good old fashioned co-op FPS action, Half-Life remake dev's Rogue Point has finally hit early access
item.description: Choosing to wear both chaotic and strategic hats, Rogue Point is the co-op shooter from the team behind Half-Life’s Black Mesa remake.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Season 2 is well-packed with additions, but it's missing the killer element to lure me back in
item.description: All of Battlefield 6 and Redsec’s Season 2 content has been revealed, but with no massive surprises, I'm finding it hard to get excited.

item.title: Cities Skylines 2's new developer is already cooking up big changes, but you'll be able to choose which ones you want
item.description: The first Cities Skylines 2 update under new developer Iceflake Studios includes a new UI, improved terraforming tools, and fewer bicycles.

item.title: Nvidia GeForce Now just landed on Amazon Fire TV, making couch PC gaming easier than ever
item.description: Stream your PC games to any Amazon Fire TV device and enjoy up to RTX 5080 performance, with only a Bluetooth controller needed to play.

item.title: High on Life 2's horrible personality gets in the way of a truly great shooter
item.description: High on Life 2’s gunplay is absolutely stellar, but its humor is grating, unfunny, and honestly, a bad distraction from the actual shooting.
